custody: targets recompiled from visible text with the pinned compiler; no sealed or eval file of Q3 or of the B package opened by this preparation

arm_meaning.A: existing family-G teaching: visible Q3 v0.7 G train rows (minus the reserved panel rows)
arm_meaning.B: the pinned CAS SDG lesson package, families A-C train split (minus any panel content); no D

edits.kind_rule: presence iff field in (drive, register) and 'None' in (from, to); value otherwise

frozen.init: torch.manual_seed(seed); torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed); deterministic flags; build_model(NeuralConfig(64), device='cuda:0'); AdamW; then the seeded order (q4_smoke_job._worker order)

frozen.loss: torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, gold): full vocabulary, mean over target positions, EOS included
frozen.missing_panel: LONGER_OR_DEEPER_THAN_TAUGHT: directive section 8's fourth panel is NOT built. The only such visible rows are the protected Q3 G eval (depths 4-5), which no loop may touch
frozen.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001); every other argument at the torch default
frozen.order: epoch e: perm = list(range(n)); rng.shuffle(perm) with ONE random.Random(seed) for the whole run; epoch 0 equals q4_smoke_job's random.Random(seed).shuffle(order)

panels.B_DEV: the B package's own dev split: B-INTERNAL, reported for both arms, never decisive
panels.SP1: FAMILIAR_STRUCTURE_NEW_CONTENT: 256 visible Q3 G train rows reserved before any arm, drawn from the rows the diagnostic never showed, allocated to the 16 G-train shapes in proportion to their rows (largest remainder), never taught to either arm (shared; decisive)
panels.SP2: NEW_STRUCTURE: all 256 visible Q3 G dev rows (9 held-out depth-3 shapes; shared). SP2U = the 208 rows never inspected (decisive); SP2ALL = all 256 (reported and labelled)
panels.TEACH_FIT: the first 64 rows of the run's own first epoch: per-run teaching fit, never compared

rules.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_JUSTIFIED: calibration state INPUT_USE_RULE_SILENT_AT_INITIALISATION, every run that has a FINAL reading (valid or not) is NONE, each arm has at least 2 valid NONE runs (coordinator decision 3 of 2026-09-24), and no run has a FINAL checkpoint file present or expected without a FINAL reading (verification of 793a4f68, W1; Y1 of the review of c0b2faad)
rules.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_NOT_JUSTIFIED_BY_INP: calibration state INPUT_USE_RULE_SILENT_AT_INITIALISATION and some arm SHOWS_INPUT_USE; teaching fit is not tested
rules.ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_INCOMPLETE: otherwise, with every reason that applies from INPUT_USE_RULE_FIRES_AT_INITIALISATION, CHECKPOINT0_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING, TEACHER_FORCED_ONLY, PARTIAL_FIELDS, STRUCTURE_OR_OUTPUT_VARIATION, SEED_DEPENDENT, NOT_NONE_IN_A_RUN_THAT_IS_NOT_VALID, TOO_FEW_VALID_RUNS, FINAL_CHECKPOINT_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING. When the calibration state is not silent, its one reason stands alone: CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE gives CHECKPOINT0_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING, INPUT_USE_RULE_FIRES_AT_INITIALISATION gives itself
rules.ARM: when the calibration state is INPUT_USE_RULE_SILENT_AT_INITIALISATION: SHOWS_INPUT_USE iff FULL in at least 2 valid runs; SHOWS_NO_INPUT_USE iff NONE in at least 2 valid runs, every run of the arm that has a FINAL reading (valid or not) is NONE, and no run of the arm has a FINAL checkpoint file present or expected without a FINAL reading; INPUT_USE_UNDETERMINED otherwise. When only that last condition fails, SHOWS_NO_INPUT_USE is withheld with the reason FINAL_CHECKPOINT_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING (coordinator decision 2 of 2026-09-24 on the review of f32b5739; reading confirmed 2026-09-24). SHOWS_INPUT_USE is never withheld for such a file: it counts valid FULL runs only, and a run whose FINAL checkpoint file gives no reading is never valid. When the calibration state is not silent, every arm is INPUT_USE_UNDETERMINED with the calibration reason alone: INPUT_USE_RULE_FIRES_AT_INITIALISATION, or CHECKPOINT0_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING for CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE (N1 of the review of c0b2faad)
rules.B_BEATS_A: per seed pair, exact canonical tree, paired rows: b = B exact and A not, c = A exact and B not; b > c and P(X >= b | b+c, 1/2) <= 1/100
rules.CALIBRATION_GUARD: fires iff some run passes T1, T2V or T2P at checkpoint 0. Distinct free outputs (and so T3) are NOT in the guard: an untrained model's free outputs may vary. The checkpoint-0 distinct-output count of every run is reported
rules.CALIBRATION_STATE: one of INPUT_USE_RULE_SILENT_AT_INITIALISATION, INPUT_USE_RULE_FIRES_AT_INITIALISATION, CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE, in this order: CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE iff some run's checkpoint-0 file exists or is expected (EXPECTED_FILE) but gives no checkpoint-0 reading (whatever the readable runs show); else INPUT_USE_RULE_FIRES_AT_INITIALISATION iff the guard fires over the runs with a checkpoint-0 reading; else INPUT_USE_RULE_SILENT_AT_INITIALISATION (coordinator decision 1 of 2026-09-24 on X1 of the review of f32b5739; Y1 of the review of c0b2faad)
rules.CHECKPOINT0_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING: a run's checkpoint-0 file exists or is expected (EXPECTED_FILE) but gives no checkpoint-0 reading (absent, missing run manifest, run identity differs, wrong identity, a file holding no record, or any recomputation failure in that file, including an exact-flag check on any panel). The calibration state is CALIBRATION_UNREADABLE and the architecture label is INCOMPLETE with this reason only. Makes both JUSTIFIED and NOT_JUSTIFIED rarer, never more common
rules.EXPECTED_FILE: a run's FINAL checkpoint file is expected iff its run_result.json or reload_check.json exists; its checkpoint-0 file is expected iff any later checkpoint file, run_result.json or reload_check.json exists; when job_result.json has status COMPLETE, every run it lists is expected with all its files (a COMPLETE record without a list of run names lists all 6 runs). An expected file that is absent gets the same flag as a present file without a reading; PRESENT in the names FINAL_CHECKPOINT_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING and CHECKPOINT0_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING means present or expected. So a run with a FINAL reading and no checkpoint-0 file is flagged. Only makes decisive labels rarer (Y1 of the review of c0b2faad; coordinator decisions queued 2026-09-24)
rules.FIELDS_NOT_READ_IN_ANY_RUN: information only; justifies nothing by itself: emitted iff at least one run has a FINAL reading and no run passes T1 or T2V at the FINAL checkpoint (valid or not); names the target for a later, separately approved design discussion (coordinator decision 4 of 2026-09-24). Scope: runs with a FINAL reading only; a run whose FINAL checkpoint file gives no reading is listed beside it, not covered by it
rules.FINAL_CHECKPOINT_PRESENT_WITHOUT_READING: a run's FINAL checkpoint file exists or is expected (EXPECTED_FILE) but gives no FINAL reading (absent, missing run manifest, run identity differs, wrong identity, or any recomputation failure in that file, including an exact-flag check on any panel). Withholds JUSTIFIED and its arm's SHOWS_NO_INPUT_USE; never changes NOT_JUSTIFIED, SHOWS_INPUT_USE or the calibration state
rules.LESSONS_HELP: B_BEATS_A in all 3 seed pairs, per panel
rules.LESSONS_OVERALL: over the primary panels SP1 and SP2U, in order: NOT_EVALUATED if either is; COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE if either is; MIXED if one is HELP and the other HURT; HURT if either is HURT; HELP if both are HELP; EFFECT_NOT_SHOWN otherwise
rules.LEVELS: checked in order, with D = distinct free outputs on SP1: FULL = T1 and T2V and T3; TEACHER_FORCED_ONLY = (T1 or T2V) and not T3; PARTIAL_FIELDS = T3 and exactly one of T1, T2V; STRUCTURE_OR_OUTPUT_VARIATION = not T1 and not T2V and (T2P or D >= 2); NONE = not T1 and not T2V and not T2P and D = 1

NONE.meaning: TOTAL collapse only: T1, T2V and T2P all fail and the run gives exactly 1 distinct free output over the 256 SP1 rows; 2 or more is never NONE (coordinator decision 1 of 2026-09-24)

rules.RUN_IDENTITY: the run manifest's arm (a string), seed (an int) and pool_ids_digest (sha256 of the canonical JSON list prep.json pools.<arm>.ids) must equal the run folder's arm and seed and prep.json's pool of that arm; otherwise the run is RUN_INVALID_RUN_IDENTITY_DIFFERS, gives no reading at all, and its checkpoint-0 and FINAL files, when present or expected, are flagged as files without a reading (N3 of the review of c0b2faad; coordinator decisions queued 2026-09-24)

T1.null_rate: max(most-frequent noetic rate in the arm's teaching pool, most-frequent noetic rate among the SP1 targets)
T1.test: exact one-sided binomial P(X >= k | n, p0) <= alpha, on grammar-masked teacher-forced choices at every noetic position of SP1

T2P.meaning: reading of drive/register presence (input length or layout) only
T2P.test: u = edits with p_new(edited) - p_new(original) >= delta, d = edits with <= -delta; pass iff u >= min_share x (edits of this kind) and exact one-sided sign test P(X >= u | u+d, 1/2) <= alpha

T2V.meaning: field-value reading with the correct previous tokens
T2V.test: u = edits with p_new(edited) - p_new(original) >= delta, d = edits with <= -delta; pass iff u >= min_share x (edits of this kind) and exact one-sided sign test P(X >= u | u+d, 1/2) <= alpha

T3.meaning: free generation has not collapsed. NOT evidence of field-value reading: a structure-only reader reaches 180 distinct outputs on SP1. Separates FULL from TEACHER_FORCED_ONLY
T3.test: distinct free-decoded token sequences on SP1 >= min_distinct

smoke.reload: fresh-process reload of smoke run A_first; SMOKE_RELOAD_FAILED unless RELOAD_REPRODUCED
